description: This file defines a mock database class for notification style data used in desktop or mobile applications, including several nested classes representing different notification styles (BigText, BigPicture, Inbox, Messaging). It provides singleton access methods and sample data for each notification style.

classes.name: MockDatabase
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to access mock notification data.

classes.name: BigTextStyleReminderAppData
classes.description: Nested static class holding data for BigTextStyle notifications; singleton pattern used for instance retrieval.

classes.name: BigPictureStyleSocialAppData
classes.description: Nested static class holding data for BigPictureStyle notifications; singleton pattern used for instance retrieval.

classes.name: InboxStyleEmailAppData
classes.description: Nested static class holding data for InboxStyle notifications; singleton pattern used for instance retrieval.

classes.name: MessagingStyleCommsAppData
classes.description: Nested static class holding data for MessagingStyle notifications; singleton pattern used for instance retrieval.

methods.name: getBigTextStyleData
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of BigTextStyleReminderAppData with predefined notification data.

methods.name: getBigPictureStyleData
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of BigPictureStyleSocialAppData with predefined notification data.

methods.name: getInboxStyleData
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of InboxStyleEmailAppData with predefined notification data.

methods.name: getMessagingStyleData
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of MessagingStyleCommsAppData with predefined message data.
